available.label: Available
available.description: Connect it and Portfolio shows its readings.

connect.label: Connect now, readings next
connect.description: You can connect it today. Portfolio does not show its readings yet.

services.name: Cloudflare
services.shows: Traffic, unique visitors, status codes and security events for each site, with drill-downs by country, page, error and event.
services.credential: A read-only API token, from a prefilled form. Portfolio lists the zones it can read and reminds you to rotate it every 90 days.

services.name: Google Search Console
services.shows: How people find your sites through Google search.
services.credential: A service account key with read-only access, set up step by step.

services.name: PostHog
services.shows: How people use your product, from your own product analytics. US and EU cloud.

services.name: Better Stack
services.credential: A Better Stack team API token.

services.name: GitHub
services.shows: The state of the repositories behind each product.
services.credential: A fine-grained personal access token with read-only repository access, set up step by step.
